{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Confirm the cleaning worked
cleaned_sample = sales['revenue_clean'].head(10)
print("Cleaned revenue values (first 10):", cleaned_sample.values)

# Check for the QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders found: {len(qa_orders)}")
print("QA order sample:")
print(qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'revenue', 'revenue_clean']])"}
